verdict.rationale: Twilio's own Phone Numbers APIs are documented to let you search for and buy available Twilio phone numbers, which covers the core of the story. The specific area-code search filter, local-number type selection, and the 'in minutes' speed are not evidenced. Regulatory bundle requirements suggest some purchases may need extra compliance steps. Missing for 10: documented area-code search parameter, explicit local-number purchase flow, evidence of minutes-level time-to-number, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes

citations.quote: With the Phone Numbers APIs, you can search for and buy available Twilio phone numbers, manage your Twilio numbers
